subject.title: fix(telegram): surface draft stream delivery failures at warn level

question: Should the missing-preview-message-id case emit the new trusted `message.delivery.error` diagnostic, or should this PR remain limited to warn-level logging?
rationale: The logging repair is well evidenced, but the added diagnostic extends the observable telemetry contract beyond the original operator-log fix and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the bounded diagnostic
options.body: Keep the new category because it records a terminal preview delivery attempt without exposing chat or message content.

options.title: Land logging only
options.body: Remove the diagnostic callback and retain the focused warn-level logger fix if maintainers want no telemetry-contract expansion.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded diagnostic
recommendation.body: Keep the new category because it records a terminal preview delivery attempt without exposing chat or message content.
